references.text: Amminadab is mentioned as the father of Nahshon and the father-in-law of Aaron, who married Elisheba, Amminadab's daughter.
Nahshon is mentioned in Judah's genealogy as the son of Amminadab and leader over the people of Judah.
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, is mentioned as the commander of Judah's camp and its army.
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, was the leader of the tribe of Judah in the camp arrangement.
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, was the first to present his offering at the dedication of the altar.
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, led the army of the tribe of Judah when Israel broke camp from Sinai.
Nahshon is mentioned in the genealogy as an ancestor of David through Salmon, Boaz, and Obed.
Nahshon is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy as the son of Amminadab and father of Salmon.
Nahshon is mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus as the son of Amminadab.
